grid_size_k: <int> Side length of the square grid network.
num_nodes: <int> Total number of nodes in the grid network.
num_arcs: <int> Total number of directed arcs in the grid network.
source_node: <int> Identifier of the origin node where the path must start.
target_node: <int> Identifier of the destination node where the path must end.

nodes.id: <int> Unique identifier of this node in row-major order.
nodes.row: <int> Row position of this node in the grid.
nodes.col: <int> Column position of this node in the grid.

arcs.from_node: <int> Identifier of the node where this arc originates.
arcs.to_node: <int> Identifier of the node where this arc terminates.

linear_costs: <list[int], length num_arcs> Traversal cost incurred for using each arc in the path.
quadratic_costs: <list[list[int]], shape [num_arcs][num_arcs]> Symmetric interaction cost incurred when each pair of arcs both appear in the chosen path, with zero diagonal entries.
